exposure: duration of rupture of membrane > 24 h
cohort: The study included 111 post-partum mothers with puerperal sepsis (cases) and 333 post-partum mothers without puerperal sepsis (controls) from Mekelle city public hospitals.
finding: Determinant factors for puerperal sepsis included rural residence, lack of antenatal or postnatal care, prolonged rupture of membranes, prolonged labor, frequent vaginal examinations, and cesarean section.
mod_finding: Cesarean section mode of delivery was identified as a determinant factor for puerperal sepsis (AOR: 2.8, 95% Cl: 1.48-5.20).
cross-section timing: Data was collected from March 21, 2021 to April 20, 2021 among postpartum mothers.
